articles.title: Japan Hybrid Bond Revival Driven by Acquisitions, Yield-Chasers

articles.title: Watchdog Fails AMP, Insignia Pension Products in Annual Test

articles.title: Yuan Stays Calm in Face of US Sanction Threats Over Iran
articles.summary: The yuan has barely budged this week despite growing US threats of sanctions over China’s ties to Iran, giving some strategists more confidence in their bullish calls on the currency.

articles.title: Rapidly Swelling Lakes Spur New Flood Warnings in Nepal, China
articles.summary: Rescuers scoured river valleys in Nepal and China on Friday in search of hundreds of people missing after a torrent of mud, rocks and ice tore through the area, as authorities warned that rivers blocked with debris were forming lakes and raising the risks of further flooding.

articles.title: Nasdaq Futures Dip, Treasuries Steady Before Warsh: Markets Wrap

articles.title: Yen Intervention Gains Ebb One Month on as Fundamentals Bite

articles.title: JPMorgan, Apollo Urge Inflation Focus for Warsh’s Big Speech
